question:
Select the option that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c3fa7c73b5a784a46359ef13c9743073e7fd4efc4d33a97b56bf2b6d7af8f48.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1. The symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfa1e21ae9e91202d9360caa8f2cf42e5d5a1ab1b93a50ea9f585e6511ece09b.png] is moved to the center in the second figure and then moved to the opposite corner in third figure. this pattern is going forward in next figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99480823040677cfd3a52c12c6becbefd7e6589b73a82e940d1fcfe224c6d41b.png] 

2. The symbol [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0acfcd971d712485df4081c5efb37c5113b1e4eb88314b02bbaf1ba6f8717bcd.png] is moved to the opposite corner in each figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/839c2c3374e1f4fb5931da634e8bf3fa1ad4ec8242ffc26e85761b7d47e47745.png] 

Hence, The correct answer is** "Option (4)"**.
